articles.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
articles.description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

articles.title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
articles.description: The US Defence Secretary says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

articles.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
articles.description: Ukraine accused Russia of targeting two crowded vehicles in the front line city of Kramatorsk to kill as many civilians as possible.

articles.title: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
articles.description: Hundreds have pitched their tents in central Madrid, while the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

articles.title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
articles.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.

articles.title: South Korea recalls Ukraine envoy over prisoner-of-war row
articles.description: It is the latest in a diplomatic spat after Kyiv disclosed that two North Korean prisoners were transferred to Seoul.

articles.title: Flights to Saudi capital suspended after Houthis 'attack on airport'
articles.description: Explosions were heard in Saudi Arabia's capital, including a large blast at Riyadh's international airport, where flights were subsequently halted.

articles.title: Lithuania PM confident of 'huge' NATO response if Russia attacks
articles.description: Lithuania is no stranger to the threat posed by Russia given its geography and history.

articles.title: One dead in Poland's second school attack in two days
articles.description: A school employee was killed and two others were injured after a knife attack in Poland - the second such incident in the country in two days
